issue: What standard of appellate review applies when a district court rules on a motion to amend a § 2255 motion under Rule 15(c)'s relation-back provision: abuse of discretion or de novo?

sides.position: Abuse of discretion review applies to a district court's Rule 15(c) relation-back ruling, including in § 2255 proceedings.
cases: United States v. Ciampi, 419 F.3d 20, 23 (1st Cir. 2005)
United States v. Pittman, 209 F.3d 314, 316 (4th Cir. 2000)
Frederick Coleman v. United States, No. 22-1678 (7th Cir. 2023)
Mandacina v. United States, 328 F.3d 995, 1000 (8th Cir. 2003)
Davenport v. United States, 217 F.3d 1341, 1343 n.4 (11th Cir. 2000)

sides.position: De novo review applies to a district court's Rule 15(c) relation-back ruling. (The Federal Circuit also applies de novo review, but it is not a regional circuit.)
cases: Slayton v. Am. Exp. Co., 460 F.3d 215, 227–28 (2d Cir. 2006)
United States v. Santarelli, 929 F.3d 95, 100 (3d Cir. 2019)
Durand v. Hanover Ins. Grp., Inc., 806 F.3d 367, 374 (6th Cir. 2015)
United States v. Marulanda, 226 F. App'x 709, 710 (9th Cir. 2007)
United States v. Roe, 913 F.3d 1285, 1298 (10th Cir. 2019)
Anza Tech., Inc. v. Mushkin, Inc., 934 F.3d 1359, 1367 (Fed. Cir. 2019)

quote: We also observe a split of authority in our sister circuits on this question.
cite: Frederick Coleman v. United States, No. 22-1678 (7th Cir. 2023)
